name: gke-plan-run-dispatch
description: Dispatching plan-runs against the live GKE warren (app.warren.run): export WARREN_BASE_URL=https://app.warren.run and WARREN_API_TOKEN from 'kubectl get secret warren-secrets -n warren -o jsonpath={.data.warren-api-token} | base64 -d' (context gke_warren-502318_us-west1_warren). Push seeds/plan changes to origin main FIRST, then POST /projects/prj_dp15vt7h8f4v/refresh to advance the server clone, then 'warren plan run <pl-id> --project prj_dp15vt7h8f4v --agent claude-code --ref main --no-follow'. Coordinator skips closed children on resume (verified: pl-3a79 resumed at warren-b8bf after 7 closed children). Adopt-only plans (sd plan create + sd plan adopt) group existing stray seeds into a dispatchable plan with zero new child seeds.
